name: Detector as ONNX or TorchScript
description: An object detector exported to a standard file: ONNX (.onnx) or TorchScript (.torchscript). Works with YOLO exports (v5, v8, v11 and later) and with models that give boxes, labels and scores (torchvision).

choices.label: Work it out from the file
YOLO: one table of boxes and class scores

settings.label: Image size (px)
settings.help: YOLO: images are fitted into a square of this size. Ignored when the file fixes its own input size.

choices.label: Usual for the kind of model (YOLO 0, torchvision 1)
